name: Upstash
description: Monitor Upstash serverless Redis databases for TLS enforcement and availability

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Upstash at https://console.upstash.com
2. Go to Account > Management API
3. Click Create API Key
4. Copy the API key and enter it below with your account email

credentialFields.label: Upstash Account Email
credentialFields.helpText: The email address you use to sign in to the Upstash Console.

credentialFields.label: Upstash API Key
credentialFields.helpText: From Upstash Console > Account > Management API > Create API Key.

checks.name: TLS Enabled on Database Connections
checks.description: Verify TLS is required for connections to every Upstash Redis database

checks.name: Access Restricted by IP Allowlist
checks.description: Verify Upstash Redis databases restrict connections with an IP allowlist

checks.name: App Availability
checks.description: Verify Upstash Redis databases are in a state able to serve connections
